texts.value: Binds the poly(A) tail of mRNA (PubMed:8524242). Binds to SMIM26 mRNA and plays a role in its post-transcriptional regulation (PubMed:37009826). May be involved in cytoplasmic regulatory processes of mRNA metabolism. Can probably bind to cytoplasmic RNA sequences other than poly(A) in vivo (By similarity)
Identified in a IGF2BP1-dependent mRNP granule complex containing untranslated mRNAs. Interacts with NFX1. Interacts with ZFC3H1 in a RNase-sensitive manner (PubMed:27871484)
Localized in cytoplasmic mRNP granules containing untranslated mRNAs
Expressed at low levels in resting normal T cells; following T-cell activation, however, mRNA levels are rapidly up-regulated
Arg-518 is dimethylated, probably to asymmetric dimethylarginine
Belongs to the polyadenylate-binding protein type-1 family
